text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ~♪ It brings back so many memories, truly~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Rather than a Mejiro family birthday 
banquet, getting to celebrate here at 
Tracen Academy is what makes it so 
special~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, the fact that 
we can both go to the academy and run 
together might really be an amazing thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We've celebrated birthdays and run races 
together for so long now, so let's keep 
doing this together from here on out, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, shall we keep doing 
*that* as well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
At parties, didn't you always celebrate 
all dressed up in fluffy, gorgeous gowns~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-That was because I was told to dress 
up! I know it didn't look good on me, 
okay...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't look bad on you at all, heavens 
no! I'd love for an adorable Dober to 
celebrate with me again~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not fair for the birthday star to 
say things like that... Jeez... just for a 
little bit, okay?"
